name: us032-origin-mismatch
description: 032 C4.7: config.yml declares an origin this checkout is not bound to. Refusal (exit 4) before any Jira call, naming both origins and the --accept-site invocation that accepts the change. Empty mock call log. Byte-identical across ports. SPEC_KIT_JIRA_BASE_URL is blanked on purpose: the harness exports the mock URL by default, and FR-011 exempts an environment-supplied destination, so leaving it set would prove nothing.
